== Description ==
'''M-7''' is currently the only removed entity in the [[section M|M Sector]].

== Behavior ==
When '''M-7''' spawns, it would place itself in a random position in the room, just like [[D-20]], except it can be anywhere, even through walls.

'''M-7''' cannot directly kill the player, instead, it will make loud sounds, blocking the sound from quiet entities. Sometimes, '''M-7''' will become just a pair of eyes, making whispering sounds that play Globally, further blocking entity sounds.

If doors are opened while '''M-7''' is active, '''M-7''' will instantly move to the most recent opened room and will go to a random position.

For it to disappear, it has to travel atleast 7 rooms, while also having to be active for atleast 15 seconds.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* It is recommended that you keep moving forward, since '''M-7''' will never despawn if doors aren't opened.
** You should stay near hiding spots at all times, so that you aren't ambushed by a quiet entity.

== Trivia ==
* '''M-7''' is one of the few entities that cannot kill the player.
* '''M-7''' would have been force spawned at M-900 and wouldn't despawn until M-1000 was reached.
* '''M-7''' was temporally readded in the [[April Fools 2026]] event beeing able to spawn by an event in-game.
** The event "Are you kidding me...?" was the one spawning some '''M-'''<nowiki/>'''7''''s.

== Lore ==
* All instances of '''M-7''' were Infected into [[SHA-7]].
